title: FaceCardDefinition
description: One face-card JSON document (src/server/content/faces/<face-id>.json). Several physical die slots may point at the same face (1:N). Overloads attach to the face card, not a slot. Synthetic faces are named specials only — never blank face-synthetic-<attr> generics.

symbol.description: Attribute this face produces, or shield for the untyped starting face.

rulesText.description: English inherent-effect region. Empty on identity faces (+1 Attribute is the footer, not rules text). Dual-timing faces use On roll: / On absorb: prefixes.

onRoll.description: Fired when this face is showing after a roll (bible §14). Empty until every printed On-roll clause is modelled. Legacy type members or AST op nodes.

onAbsorb.description: Fired when a symbol produced by a die showing this face is absorbed. Empty until On-absorb print is wired. On-absorb is retired as a face design axis (spec 025); leave empty on new faces.

pips.description: Inherent yield when rolled, e.g. { "mechanical": 2 } or { "luminar": 1, "mechanical": 1 }. Omitted = one pip of symbol. Spec 025. Not a Generate opcode.

convertRoll.description: If true, this die's pips from this roll do not bank (including yield and Overcharge); onRoll is the Convert roll payoff (spec 025).

whileShowing.description: Continuous stance modifiers while this face is showing on an owned die (spec 025). Not StandingTrigger.

maxOverloads.description: Capacity for overloads attached to this face card (shared across all slots showing it).

forgeRestriction.description: When echo-cards, only tactics tagged forgeTags: [echo] may install this face. null = no extra install gate.

activated.description: Player-activated face ability paid with ACTIVATE_FACE during the actions phase.

stayPolicy.description: Stay-on-slot while installed. Distinct from forgeRestriction (who may install this type).

pestilenceSpreadAt.description: Pestilent Plague: after this many counters on the physical slot, reset them and try to forge another copy onto an adjacent slot.

whileShowingModifier.title: WhileShowingModifier
whileShowingModifier.description: Closed stance union while this face is showing (spec 025).
